name: Goi ca moi
summary: Gỏi cá mòi is a herring salad. The 24 Feb 2025 sanctuary essay says cá mòi is made into gỏi at the Thu Bon festival in Duy Thu, and calls gỏi a dish Cham people liked. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Xã Duy Thu, at the Thu Bon festival, in the sanctuary essay of 24 Feb 2025.
howToEat: The essay says the fish is made into gỏi. It does not give a dressing or a herb. The method is Check on arrival.
It places the salad at lễ hội Thu Bồn in Duy Thu. Separately, it dates lễ hội Bà Thu Bồn from the 12th of the second lunar month. It does not say those are the same hour.
The price is Check on arrival.
where: Xã Duy Thu. The essay does not print a street. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Goi ca moi — herring salad at the Thu Bon festival
seoDescription: The 24 Feb 2025 sanctuary essay puts gỏi cá mòi at the Thu Bon festival in Duy Thu. No dressing and no price were printed.
